site_area_sqm.display_rounding: nearest 1,000 sqm; display_value is a low-precision human label
assumptions: Provisional boundary, not an official redline.

Audit value is retained at geometry precision; human-facing display_value is intentionally low precision and must not imply statutory precision. Official boundary release triggers immediate recalculation.
site_area_sqm.recompute_trigger: Official overall-design boundary release (per announcement textual caliber about 11.4 km2) - recompute by the same formula and update all displays.

green_space_area_sqm.display_rounding: nearest 1,000 sqm; display_value is a low-precision human label
assumptions: Audit value is retained at geometry precision; human-facing display_value is intentionally low precision. Design-layer caliber, not the land-class share.
green_space_area_sqm.recompute_trigger: Official green-space data release - recompute by the same formula.

public_space_area_sqm.display_rounding: nearest 1,000 sqm; display_value is a low-precision human label
assumptions: Design-layer caliber, not a service-radius conclusion.
public_space_area_sqm.recompute_trigger: Official public-space data release - recompute by the same formula.

assumptions: Conceptual reuse-first envelopes only; not an approved building scale or FAR basis.
building_footprint_area_sqm.recompute_trigger: Official building survey release - recompute by the same formula.

green_ratio.display_rounding: ratio rounded to 3 decimals; percent display rounded to 1 decimal
assumptions: Audit ratio is retained from the geometry-derived numerator and denominator; human-facing display_value is ~12.4%. Distinct from the land-class share of park green space (26.94%).
green_ratio.recompute_trigger: Official green-space and boundary data release - recompute by the same formula.

public_space_ratio.display_rounding: ratio rounded to 3 decimals; percent display rounded to 2 decimals
assumptions: Audit ratio is retained from the geometry-derived numerator and denominator; human-facing display_value is ~0.45%.
public_space_ratio.recompute_trigger: Official public-space and boundary data release - recompute by the same formula.

assumptions: Conceptual slow-traffic network length; display precision rounded to whole meters.
road_network_length_m.recompute_trigger: Official road network release - recompute by the same formula.

assumptions: Three key nodes: safe school route, children's playground, family service stop.
key_area_count.recompute_trigger: Official key-area geometry release - re-cut and recompute.

landmark_count.formula: count(pilgrimage landmark catalogue rows in proposal.md 重点区域详细设计)
assumptions: Three children's pilgrimage landmarks: Play Tree House, Loop Lighthouse, Warm House.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(industry_validation test scenario rows in proposal.md 统筹研究范围)
assumptions: Three concept test scenarios: school-route safety co-governance, playground playfulness, family-stop basic service.

persona_count.formula: count(representative user groups in proposal.md AI 创新生态 section)
assumptions: Six personas: primary-school children, parents, grandparent caregivers, school teachers, young families, community volunteers.

global_case_count.formula: count(global ecosystem mechanism case rows in proposal.md case table)
assumptions: Six registered global AI ecosystem cases: CERN openlab, AIST ABCI, Singapore AI Verify, EuroHPC AI Factories, Vector Institute, and Mila; six child-friendly/slow-mobility cases remain background mechanism references.

annual_program_count.formula: count(annual programme rows in proposal.md 更新项目清单 section)
assumptions: Three concept programmes: Play Week, Safe Commute Day, Family Nature Season.
